scope: v2 — 4-module MVP + Auth + Payments + Marketing Site + Blog + 10x features (Mold Volume Calculator, Recipe Intelligence, Making Mode, Template Recipes)

waves.name: Foundation + Auth + Payments
waves.description: Auth flow, Dodo Payments, marketing site/app separation, colour palette

waves.name: Core Features + 10x
waves.description: Recipe Builder with mold volume, Making Mode, Template Recipes, Batch Log, Cure Tracker, Costing

waves.name: Marketing Site + Blog + Polish
waves.description: Marketing site pages, blog, SEO, design polish, launch

tasks.title: Auth flow — login, signup, password reset, auth gate
tasks.description: Email/password auth with session persistence. Auth gate on all app routes. Marketing site is public, app is gated.
tasks.uxFocus: Clean auth gate, no friction on marketing site
acceptanceCriteria: User can sign up with email + password
User can log in and access the dashboard
Auth gate redirects unauthenticated users to marketing site
tasks.tdd: signup → login → auth gate → session persistence

tasks.title: Dodo Payments integration — subscription management
tasks.description: Dodo Payments integration for Free tier and Pro tier ($12/mo or $99/yr). Subscription management page in Account Settings.
tasks.uxFocus: Seamless upgrade flow, clear tier boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: Free tier: calculator + 3 recipes + 1 active batch
Tier gates enforced on all features
tasks.tdd: free tier works → upgrade CTA → Dodo Payments → Pro tier active

tasks.title: Marketing site — homepage, pricing, blog, SEO
tasks.description: Public marketing site with homepage, pricing page, blog (programmatic SEO), and auth gate. Separate from the app.
tasks.uxFocus: Clean marketing page, drives signups, SEO-optimised
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage loads in < 1s with hero, demo, features, workflow, pricing teaser
Pricing page shows Free and Pro tiers
Marketing site links to app, app links back to marketing site
tasks.tdd: homepage → pricing → blog → signup → auth gate → app

tasks.title: Colour palette + design tokens applied to all components
tasks.description: Apply the warm cream + dark charcoal + amber accent colour palette to all components. Semantic colours (success, warning, error, info). No black and white, no generic blue/purple.
acceptanceCriteria: All components use the colour palette tokens
Semantic colours used correctly (success=green, warning=amber, error=terracotta, info=blue-gray)
No black and white, no generic blue/purple

tasks.title: Recipe Builder — core form + mold volume calculator
tasks.description: Recipe creation form with oil selection, percentage-based blending, SAP calc, lye/water calc, superfat, property ranges, warnings, validation, batch scaling, save to library. PLUS mold volume calculator (enter mold dimensions → calculates oil volumes).
tasks.uxFocus: Oil selection with SAP values, mold volume calculator, property ranges, warnings panel
acceptanceCriteria: Select oils → set percentages → calculate → see lye, water, fragrance load, property ranges
Mold volume calculator: enter dimensions → calculates oil volumes
Calculation reveal animation (subtle checkmark per metric)
tasks.tdd: select oils → set percentages → calculate → mold volume → save

tasks.title: Making Mode — guided CP batch production with smart guidance
tasks.description: Making Mode for Cold Process with guided step-by-step checklist, persistent timers, temperature tracking, and smart guidance (contextual next-step prompts, not just timers).
tasks.uxFocus: Contextual guidance, not just timers. Smart next-step prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: CP batch gets guided step checklist
Persistent timers that survive page reloads
Safety checklist required before starting CP batch
Making Mode preserves user input on error
tasks.tdd: start batch → guided steps → timers → safety checklist → complete

tasks.title: Template Recipes — pre-built recipes for common soap types
tasks.description: Pre-built recipes for common soap types (castile, French milled, milk soap, etc.) that users can customize. New soap makers can make their first batch in 2 minutes instead of 30.
tasks.uxFocus: Quick start for new users, reduce time-to-first-batch
acceptanceCriteria: Template recipes for common soap types (castile, French milled, milk soap)
Customized recipes save to personal library
First batch can be created from a template in < 2 minutes
tasks.tdd: browse templates → select → customize → save → create batch

tasks.title: Batch Log + Cure Tracker + Costing (existing features, polished)
tasks.description: Existing Batch Log, Cure Tracker, and Costing features polished with the new colour palette, unified navigation, and coherent interfaces between modules.
tasks.uxFocus: Coherent interfaces between modules, unified navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Cure Tracker shows estimated windows (not declarations)
Costing shows real-time cost per batch + per bar + target price
tasks.tdd: create batch → log → cure → cost → complete

tasks.title: Recipe Intelligence — AI-powered oil suggestions
tasks.description: AI-powered recipe suggestions based on user goals. 'You want a hard bar with creamy lather — try 60% olive, 30% coconut, 10% shea.' Deterministic calc is the authority; AI explains and recommends only.
tasks.uxFocus: Contextual suggestions, not overrides. AI explains, calc decides.
acceptanceCriteria: AI suggests oil blends based on user goals
User can accept or reject suggestions
Deterministic calc is always the authority
tasks.tdd: user sets goal → AI suggests → user accepts/rejects → calc verifies

tasks.title: Account Settings + Subscription Management page
tasks.description: Account Settings page with profile management, subscription details, payment methods, and account deletion. Subscription management page with upgrade/downgrade actions.
acceptanceCriteria: User can update profile email and name
User can view current subscription tier and billing cycle
tasks.tdd: view settings → update profile → manage subscription → cancel/delete

tasks.title: Blog — programmatic SEO articles
tasks.description: Blog with programmatic SEO articles targeting soap-making queries. Content pillars: Soap Calculators, Soap Recipes, Soap Making Guides, Troubleshooting. Each article is a standalone SEO asset with internal links to the app.
tasks.uxFocus: SEO-optimised content, drives organic traffic to marketing site
acceptanceCriteria: SEO articles for all 4 content pillars
Internal links to the app from blog articles
tasks.tdd: blog homepage → article → internal link → signup → app

tasks.title: Pricing page — Free vs Pro tier details
tasks.description: Dedicated pricing page with Free tier and Pro tier details, comparison table, and upgrade CTA. SEO-optimised for 'soap making software' queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Pricing page shows Free and Pro tier details
Upgrade CTA leads to Dodo Payments Checkout
tasks.tdd: view pricing → compare tiers → upgrade → Dodo Payments → Pro active

tasks.title: Unified navigation — workflow progression (not flat links)
tasks.description: Navigation shows workflow progression (Recipes → Batches → Cure → Costing) with visual separators. Not a flat list of links — a coherent product flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation shows Recipe → Batch → Cure → Cost progression
tasks.tdd: navigate recipes → batches → cure → costing → back

tasks.title: Design quality pass — scan-generic.sh on all components
tasks.description: Run scan-generic.sh from impeccable-design skill on all PRs. Fix any banned patterns detected.
tasks.uxFocus: Anti-generic pass — all hard bans from impeccable-design skill
acceptanceCriteria: Visual audit complete — no generic-looking UI elements

tasks.title: Launch checklist — monitoring, SEO, community seeding
tasks.description: Post-launch instrumentation, error tracking, performance monitoring. SEO content (10 pages). Community seeding (r/soapmaking, SoapCalc, Soapmaking Forum).
acceptanceCriteria: Error tracking and performance monitoring active
SEO content live: 10 pages across 4 pillars
